pick.name: Microsoft Clipchamp (free)
pick.what: Browser-based editor built into Windows 11 with templates, 9:16 presets and AI auto-subtitles
pick.why: Runs fine without a GPU, free 1080p exports with no watermark, auto captions included; nothing extra to install on Windows 11
pick.free_limits: Free: 1080p export, no watermark, AI subtitles, free stock; 4K, brand kit, premium stock need Microsoft 365 Personal/Family

alts.name: Kdenlive
alts.what: Open-source multitrack editor with local Whisper/VOSK speech-to-text subtitles
alts.why: Best free desktop editor with no account; local captions (Whisper slower on CPU, ~2 GB setup)

alts.name: Descript
alts.what: Edit video by editing the transcript; AI clean-up
alts.why: Best pay-later tool for talking-head + screen demos; free tier is watermarked 720p
alts.free_limits: Free: 60 media min/mo, 720p, watermark, 100 one-time AI credits; Hobbyist $16/mo annual

candidates.name: Clipchamp
candidates.verdict: PICK: free, no GPU, no watermark, captions

candidates.name: Kdenlive
candidates.verdict: Best OSS desktop editor; Whisper setup on Windows has had dependency bugs

candidates.name: Descript
candidates.verdict: Best text-based editing; paid for clean exports

candidates.name: CapCut
candidates.verdict: Banned in India since 2020-06-29 under IT Act s.69A; still blocked per June 2026 guides; VPN/APK use does not change legal status; do not use

candidates.name: DaVinci Resolve
candidates.verdict: Free but needs GPU with >=4 GB VRAM and 16 GB RAM; poor fit for a laptop without a GPU

candidates.name: Shotcut
candidates.verdict: OSS (v26.9.27) but no built-in auto captions

candidates.name: VN Video Editor (Android)
candidates.verdict: Closest mobile CapCut replacement, no watermark (per FluxNote guide)

candidates.name: OpenScreen
candidates.verdict: Use for screen-recorded demos with auto-zoom/captions, then finish in Clipchamp

decision: CapCut is still blocked in India, so Clipchamp is the best Windows replacement on a laptop without a GPU: free, no watermark, auto captions, and it does not need a GPU. Use Kdenlive when you want an offline, open-source editor, and Descript (paid) once you produce weekly talking-head content.
details: Capture with OpenScreen or ShareX, then edit.

verify.note: CapCut ban (2020-06-29, IT Act s.69A) is well documented; the PIB primary page returned 403 here, and 'still blocked in 2026' rests on secondary guides. Low risk. | Clipchamp pricing page: free 1080p, no watermark; 4K on paid. Commercial-use terms not on page.
